# Agent Plugins v1 schema snapshots

These are offline snapshots of the published Agent Plugins v1.0.0 schemas:

- <https://agent-plugins.org/schemas/1.0.0/plugin.schema.json>
- <https://agent-plugins.org/schemas/1.0.0/mcp.schema.json>

They were retrieved on 2026-08-12 and compared with the live canonical schemas
on 2026-09-13; both parsed JSON documents are unchanged. The `$id` fields bind tests to the canonical
schema identifiers declared by the generated package. Refresh these fixtures
deliberately when Primr moves to a newer Agent Plugins specification.
